title: Mamemaki
description:
This project will create a personal token platform on Matic that will make it easier for creators, such as Virtual YouTubers, to return value to their funs without too many fees.
- We use Matic so that Youtuber can issue and distribute their own tokens at a low fee.
- We use Torus so that Fans can receive the tokens with their Google or Twitter account.
how_its_made:
Personal tokens are created with the factory pattern.

The total amount of tokens issued is fixed, and the amount of tokens issued is reduced based on a curve.

We used the Matic Network to reduce the cost of gas and to speed up the creation and distribution of tokens.

To improve the user experience, Torus Wallet was incorporated into the app.
